## Change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and why this scope is needed.
Link the issue or confirmed regression when available.

## Validation

List the checks actually executed and their results. Separate unrun or blocked
checks from passing ones. For UI-related changes, record workflow/visual evidence;
for backend changes, update the source-matched review ledger where required.

## Compatibility

Describe any effect on saved queues, command/event contracts, cancellation,
resource limits, or user-visible behavior. Note any remaining qualification work.

Confirm you have the author's written permission required by [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
